name: sfx.synth
title: SFX synthesis
summary: Synthesize sound effects from a recipe module: a workspace .mjs or the built-in generic recipes. Each sound is finished (trim, fades, normalise), written as a WAV and measured.
description: Runs a sound-effect recipe and renders each named sound with the shared DSP kit at 48 kHz stereo. A recipe is a workspace .mjs/.js file, or the built-in `generic` recipes. Recipe contract: `export const sounds = { name(kit, params) { /* return [Float32Array, Float32Array] at kit.SR (48000) */ } }` (a sound may be async); optionally `export const finish = { name: { peak_db: -3 } }` for per-sound finish overrides and `export const describe = { name: 'one line' }` for descriptions. `kit` is the DSP kit (osc, noise, filters, envelopes, crush, reverb, echo, pal, rng, ...). `params[name]` is passed through from the request. Every sound is finished with the `finish` options (DC block, head/tail trim, fades, peak normalise), written to `<name>.wav`, and measured. `sounds.json` holds the per-sound results.

recipe.description: Workspace path/ref to a .mjs or .js recipe module exporting `sounds` (and optionally `describe`/`finish`). Exactly one of `recipe` or `builtin` is required.

builtin.description: Use the built-in generic recipes instead of a workspace module. Exactly one of `recipe` or `builtin` is required.

items.description: A sound name exported by the recipe's `sounds` object.

sounds.description: Sound names to render, in order. Omit to render every sound the recipe exports.

params.description: Recipe parameters keyed by sound name. Each value is passed to the recipe as its second argument.

additionalProperties.description: Parameters for one sound; arbitrary keys, read by the recipe.

palette.description: Named palette audio files that recipes slice with kit.pal(name, k, slot); each is decoded to 48 kHz stereo before the recipe runs.

additionalProperties.description: Workspace path/ref to an audio file to decode into the palette.

finish.description: Finish options applied to every sound. These override a recipe's per-sound `finish` export.

head.description: Trim leading near-silence (below head_db) before normalising.

head_db.description: Head-trim threshold in dBFS (relative to the sound's peak).

tail_db.description: Tail-trim threshold in dBFS (relative to the sound's peak).

fade_out_s.description: Fade-out length in seconds (capped at a third of the sound).

peak_db.description: Target peak in dBFS after normalisation.

format.description: WAV bit depth: wav = 16-bit, wav24 = 24-bit, wav32f = 32-bit float.

seed.description: PRNG seed for the kit; the same seed renders the same sound.

sounds.description: One entry per rendered sound, in request order.

file.description: Output WAV path (POSIX, relative to the job's out folder).

peak_db.description: Sample peak in dBFS after finishing.

rms_db.description: RMS level in dBFS over the whole sound.

peak_at_s.description: Time of the sample peak in seconds from the start.

momentary_max_lufs.description: Maximum 400 ms momentary loudness in LUFS, or null when the sound is shorter than the window.

integrated_lufs.description: Integrated (EBU R128) loudness in LUFS, or null when the sound is too short.

description.description: The recipe's `describe` line for this sound, when present.
